notes: Health drops each second and with each hit. Lunch adds 100; do not shoot it.
Keys open gates, a bell clears the screen. Treasure, keys, bells 100; monsters 5 thrown at, 25 hand to hand.

victories: send the principal away with the bell.
take a stairwell that skips ahead.
readme: Locker Gauntlet: arrow keys or WASD walk, hold Space to stand and throw, Shift rings a bell, P pauses. Health counts down; lunch brings it back.
claude: - Locker Gauntlet (owner 2026-10-26, locker order): authentic 1985 Gauntlet rules and scoring (src/gauntlet, 25 rule checks), the jock alone in the locker hallways going deeper: hall pass ghosts, hall monitors, dodgeball kids, paper wad lobbers, the vanishing substitute and the principal for Death, brick offices for generators; same amendment list.
